notes.title: Hotfix update 5.0.2
notes.notes:
⏱️ Bill's time, including extra seconds, is now properly updated in time trials.
👻 Bill's ghost no longer appears in time trials, but the player's ghost still does.
🎩 Increased the chance of getting the Spinning Hat skin to 5% when receiving an event balloon.
🧠 Improved difficulty in Cachefalls in Bouncy mode.
📝 Fixed incorrect text in the Cokko ranking rewards.
🧊 Fixed cubes that couldn’t be bounced on in Arcade mode.
🕳️ Online objects can no longer appear under the floor in EYE.CO offices.

notes.title: Hotfix 5.0.1
notes.notes:
🔁 Fixed issue with chat shortcut that repeated messages.

🌍 Added some missing phrases in English, Russian, and Japanese.

📩 Bill’s message now triggers when falling even lower in the Fitxel area, without interrupting the normal level progression.

🎓 Made the tutorial in bouncy mode a bit easier.

🎬 Fixed an issue that prevented the cutscene from triggering after defeating a SAM.

🚫 It’s no longer possible to open the online popup or chat shortcut while sending messages in Shike Garden.

📚 The book cutscenes in Shike’s mansion now display correctly in mirror mode.

👁️‍🗨️ The battle with Luceye now displays correctly in mirror mode.

🏭 The factory cameras now display correctly in mirror mode.

💬 Factory cameras no longer block the online popup and chat shortcut after being destroyed.

⏱️ Factory cameras now disappear when the time trial is activated to make it fairer.

🌳 Event objects and chests can no longer appear inside trees in Core Square.

👥 The online chat shortcut no longer interferes with NPC dialogues.

🌞 The online chat shortcut no longer interferes with the day-night activator.

🔘 The online chat shortcut no longer interferes with buttons and switches.

🎨 Returning to the main menu from the game no longer shows the anniversary background.

⚡ Glitches in SAMmy now kill the player in rebound mode.

⚙️ Changed appearance of SAMuel’s switch and access to SAMmy. Added an arrow to better indicate what the switch affects.

🎼 Fixed visual issues in the music credits area.

😢 SAManta’s “I’m sorry” message no longer overlaps with the message dedicated to Sam.

⏳ Added more time to rebound mode time trials: +60 seconds for SAMus, +60 seconds for System Debugger, +30 seconds for SAMmy, +15 seconds for Factory, +15 seconds for Blind Compiler, +10 seconds for Forgotten Islands, +10 seconds for Test EYE.CO, +10 seconds for the Old testing area, +10 seconds for Short Circuit, and +5 seconds by default to all other levels.

💡 Improved lighting and color change animation in Blind Compiler.

🛠️ Changes in rebound mode levels to make them fairer or better balanced: Core Square, SAManta, SAMmy, Blind Compiler, You Fell, Cacheratas, and Old Commercial Zone.

🔫 SAMus now fires fewer shots on medium difficulty. (Previously it was the same as hard.) Resume: 4 shots on easy, 6 on medium, and 8 on hard.

🚀 In bouncy mode, SAMus’s shots stop during the inverted controls section, and in the Save Zone spawns section only half are fired (2 on easy, 3 on medium, 4 on hard).

🐛 Fixed an issue in time trials where having 3 jumps and playing a 2-jump trial for the first time would incorrectly limit jumps. If you play a 2-jump level for the first time while having 3 jumps, the time trial is not made invisible.

🎨 Art gallery updated.

[h1]Update 4.1.0 Highlights[/h1]

🏔️ [b]New DEPO Maker Object: Procedural Terrain[/b]
Create your own terrain! Customize the size, height, colors, and even make it generate infinitely.  
[i](Not recommended to generate very large terrains infinitely — your PC might get dizzy.)[/i]

🚫 [b]New DEPO Maker Object: Anti-Cheat Sign[/b]
Place it anywhere in your level to block players from using cheat codes.

🚀 [b]New DEPO Maker Object: Missile Target [/b] 
Targets that give keys when hit by a missile. You can choose where the key will appear.

🦹‍♂️ [b]Story Mode Style for NPCs[/b]
NPCs in DEPO Maker can now wear outfits from story mode and even mix them with online outfits.

👨‍💻 [b]New Cheat Code!  [/b]
Spawn a long ladder. Visit the Death Pixels base to find out how to activate it.

🔇 [b]Silent Start Option[/b]
You can now leave the background music empty when creating a level — perfect for silent intros or ambient builds.

📲 [b]More Accurate Online Status on PixelDeck[/b]
- Players in menus or cutscenes now show up as online.  
- Players editing in DEPO Maker now appear online too, with their status showing they’re in DEPO Maker.  
- If a friend is playing a custom level, its name will show on PixelDeck.  
- DEPO Maker levels are now listed in the online panel.

❗ [b]NEW SHORTCUTS IN THE LEVEL EDITOR!  [/b]
- Hold **Shift** while moving the camera to move 10x faster.  
- Hold **Left Click** and drag left/right on numeric fields to quickly adjust values without typing.

🖱️ [b]Better Scroll Speed![/b]
- Faster scrolling in the level editor’s level selection using the mouse wheel or controller.  
- Faster scrolling in the PixelDeck contact list too.

🌟 [b]Post-Processing Settings Are Now Persistent[/b]
- Post-processing effects now save properly and stay active during testing.  
- They also auto-enable when capturing a thumbnail before uploading a level.

📸 [b]Camera Position Memory[/b]
When you test and return to the editor, the camera stays right where you left it.



[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]

🛠️ Flashlight toggle objects now work correctly in the level editor.  
🛠️ Steam Workshop menu no longer has visual glitches when offline.  
🛠️ Fixed NPC face bug in the level editor.  
🛠️ Minor lighting and shadow issues in the editor fixed.  
🛠️ Fixed anti-cheat toggle not working properly in the editor.  
🛠️ Fixed issues with NPC skins containing text.  
🛠️ If you had a glider on via cheats and then disabled cheats, the glider now disappears properly.  
🛠️ Negative values in certain editor objects no longer cause problems.  
🛠️ Cokkoins are no longer endlessly rewarded when speeding up time online.

[h1]MAIN UPDATES[/h1]  
🎉 Steam Workshop is now available in DEPO! Create your own levels and upload them for other players to enjoy. You can also download levels from other players. It's time to get creative!  

📑 There are 6 different buttons to filter levels: most downloaded, most voted, newest, random levels, friends’ levels, and my downloads.  

🔄 Once a level has been uploaded to Steam Workshop, it can be updated if the same player uploads a level with the same name. This will replace the previous version, and an indicator with the update date will appear in the level list.  

🏃‍♂️ It is now possible to create levels with 0 jumps. Additionally, new objects in the editor allow you to increase or decrease the number of jumps for players.  

🏷️ A tagging system has been added to filter and find levels more easily.  

👍 A voting system has been added to rate levels positively or negatively.  

⏩ The DEPO Maker section now leads directly to the Steam Workshop panel, where you can access the level editor.  

🎵 A new song has been added to SAMson, Dark SAMson, the museum, and the editor.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35443786/e52abf79cd335b765ce89423de571b03a7a951de.png[/img]  





[h1]NEW OBJECTS ADDED TO THE EDITOR[/h1]  

- Basic blocks can now have physics, allowing them to be pushed or thrown. They can also be breakable with missiles or have no collision.  

- An invisible activator has been added that allows switching between Workshop levels, enabling the creation of worlds or hubs that redirect to other levels.  

- 3 new objects: add jumps, remove jumps, and restore jumps for the player.  

- Teleports have been added, allowing players to be transported to different areas within a level.  

- Volumetric fog has been added to the level editor. (Its color can be changed, and it becomes denser if moonlight is used in the level.)  

- A chasing balloon has been added to the level editor. You can now choose whether the killer balloon spawns in a fixed or random position and adjust its speed.  

- A missile launcher has been added. If it detects you, it will launch a homing missile.  

- An invisible activator has been added to the editor that triggers sounds.  

- An invisible activator has been added to the editor that plays music tracks.  

- New object added: a set of 200 boxes.  

- New object added: small decorative stones.  

- New object added: borders to enclose a level.  

- New object added: cake.  

- New object added: gray teleport.  

- New object added: castle scenery.  

- New object added: holographic ring.  

- New objects added: chips, key, and keycards.  

- Added icons and emoji images for placement.  

- NPC voices can now be selected.  

- Fixed: The Core Plaza object no longer has texture issues.  





[h1]OTHER FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]  

- Buttons can no longer be repeatedly pressed when downloading, preventing Steam overload.  

- Vote and random icons have been changed.  

- Improved lighting in the editor and test scene.  

- Improved tag icon resolution.  

- Fixed issues with undo controls.  

- Added an icon for the missile launcher.  

- All level editor texts have been updated in all languages with new phrases.  

- The level upload panel now closes automatically when updating a level.  

- Selecting the "Easy" tag will now deselect "Hard," and the same applies to the "Long" and "Short" level tags.  

- The race flag tag now activates automatically if the flag is placed in the level.  

- Texts now appear in the editor as they are typed.  

- Objects with physics now respawn at their original position if they touch lethal objects.  

- A new "Jumps" object category has been added, replacing "Others" in the editor. This has been translated into all languages.  

- Rotating objects no longer rotate in the editor, making them easier to move and adjust.  

- The level editor is designed for use with a mouse, but Workshop level menus can also be navigated using a keyboard or controller.  

- Added an error panel indicating that the local save path for a level is inaccessible.  

- The random filter now shows all published levels, even if they haven’t been downloaded or played yet.  

- Node system in the editor has been refined.  

- The names of players who are not on your friends list now appear when downloading Workshop levels.  

- A loading screen has been added when uploading a level, with a notification that it takes 1-2 minutes for it to appear publicly.  

- When subscribing to a level for the first time, the play and uninstall buttons now appear.  

- A loading screen has been added when testing a level.  

- Buttons have been visually improved.  

- A level cannot be uploaded unless a name, description, and tags have been added.  

- An option has been added to enable/disable post-processing effects on the editor camera.  

- Sounds have been added to buttons in the editor.  

- Added error messages for Steam connection issues, missing levels, and loading screens.  

- If there is no Steam connection, an error appears when trying to upload or download a level.  

- A warning appears if you attempt to exit the level editor or access community level search while a level is in progress.  

- If you subscribe/unsubscribe from a level on Steam, the changes will now update in the game when any filter button is pressed.  

- The main menu now displays: "DEPO MAKER & STEAM WORKSHOP."  

- The main menu now changes sounds for each option.  

- Player script has been optimized, potentially improving FPS.  

- Chat message resolution has been visually improved.  

- 2D arcade levels are now playable in reverse mode.  

- In the PixelDeck agenda, if you select a player without a skin, their icon now correctly appears without a skin when sending them a message.  





[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]  

- If you have a locally downloaded level that has been deleted from the Workshop, it will no longer cause a bug.  

- Fixed a bug with platforms that change when jumping.  

- Cloning multiple objects at once no longer causes them to lose their properties.  

- Fixed an issue where the "Friends' Levels" button would take too long to load—previously, the more friends you had, the longer it took. Now it loads quickly.  

- Fixed an error that displayed "unknown" when loading author names.  

- Fixed an issue when returning to the editor after loading a Workshop level from another level.  

- Fixed a problem with the size of editable texts.  

- Fixed a critical error with the interactive text object that caused level sizes to become excessively large—this bug made level file sizes 100 times bigger.  

- Fixed an issue when updating a level.  

- Fixed a problem where graphics quality would be lost when returning to the main world.  

- Corrected a bug with the flashlight in the Level Editor.  

- Some objects no longer glitch when copied in the editor.  




And probably many more things I forgot to note down! I hope you enjoy this content-packed update. I can't wait to play your levels—now it's my turn to be your player! 💜

Here is a list of information that will be of interest:

- The online system will be totally free and without any kind of payment. It will be included in the story mode of DEPO.

- Players will be able to collide with each other, but this will be disabled when performing time trials.

- Any player can see another player if they are on the same level. At the moment there is no limit to the number of players on the same level but this will be adjusted in the online tests.

- Each player keeps his own game with his own percentage, i.e. a person with a completed game can play with another who has just started.

- The introduction of cheats will only affect the person who activates them, the rest will not be affected.

- You will be able to equip your online character with new outfits and clothes. These will be obtained within the game without any kind of microtransaction.

- Each person has their own world, if you activate a button it only affects your world. The rest of the people will have the button without activating. Actually, the worlds are only shared visually.

- Each player can be in different levels. You can enter a level and your friend will remain in his until he wants to join you.

- You can see from the pause menu which players are in the current level, and a list with the number of players in other levels.

- The online mode and viewing of online player deaths can be disabled from the pause menu in a new tab.

- You will be able to see the players' names above their character.

- There will be emojis to react and communicate with the rest. There will be no text or voice chat.

notes.title: New Speedruns contest!
notes.notes:
[h1]NEW CONTEST! IT'S TIME TO BE A REAL SPEEDRUNNER![/h1]

[b]What does it consist of?[/b]
In the Fitxel Zone, a new area has been created in honor of the fastest pixels in the System, you can participate in 3 modes:
🔹  [b]Any%[/b]: beat the story mode as fast as possible.
🔹  [b]100%[/b]: beat the story mode 100% (all collectibles of clothes, eyes and rockets) as fast as possible.
🔹  [b]Less jumps[/b]: beat the story mode with the least number of jumps in the shortest time possible.

[b]How to participate?[/b]
You must record the game on video, upload the video to Youtube and ask for a review at: https://www.speedrun.com/depo
Once your attempt is validated you will appear in the ranking.

[b]Is there a prize?[/b]
The top 3 of each modality will have a statue with their name and their best time in the Fitxel Zone, and they will be able to choose the clothes they will wear on their statue!
In addition, as long as you are in the top 3 of a category you will win the role of "Bill, the speedrunner" on the Discord server.

[b]How often are the in-game statues updated?[/b]
Approximately every 15-30 days if there are changes in the top 3.

[b]What are the rules?[/b]
- The recording should have no cuts or editing, it should be done all in a row.
- The timer must start right when you choose difficulty when creating a new game.
- The stopwatch stops at the start of the last cinematic when leaving the red pixel's house.
- It is not obligatory to use the splits that are discussed below, but they help to practice and to know the current time in each section. 

[b](OPTIONAL) What are splits?[/b]
The splits are different points that are created before starting the speedrun to have a reference through a program. 
After passing that area of the game marked in the split, the time taken to pass it is shown (the speedrunner must press the 0 key of the numeric pad to register it).

[b](OPTIONAL) How do I generate splits for DEPO?[/b]
1. Placing the splits is very simple, just download the LiveSplit program from this web: https://livesplit.org/downloads/
2. Download these templates of splits and layout on DEPO that I have generated for you: https://www.speedrun.com/resourceasset/i3rnu (Although you can create your own if you want) 
3. Once you have downloaded the program, open it and right click on the window and click on Open Split and select the Split you downloaded in step 2.
4. Right click again and select Open Layout and choose the one you downloaded in step 2.
Now you have everything set up to start speedrunning professionally! 
Remember, to start counting the time and to pass from split you must press the 0 key on the number pad on the right side of the keyboard. Press the 3 key on the number pad to reset the counter.

Join the [b]Discord[/b] to speak about new optimal paths or hints! https://discord.gg/5H7uPAK
